title: 第1章 深空探索第二十章 妖兽区域
slug: 乾坤至尊诀第2791章政变再变
content_zh:
公元二0六八年十月二十五日，西太平洋日本冲绳岛东南上约一百公里处，宇航国际公司第十七次太空发射终于开始。
宇航国际是一家私营性质的宇航公司，主要承担宇航发射，空间探索，太空旅游等业务。
经过一百多年的不懈努力，人类终于制造出以核动力为最主要推进器的太空发动机的太空飞船。
有了以核动力作为推进器的太空飞船，人类才开始了真正的深空探索，才能以这种超级动力为基础，飞出太阳系，才可以实现真正载人的深空探索。
宇航国际是一家具有超强实力的国际高科技企业，主要业务有航天航空，生物制药，能源开发，卫星通讯，空间旅行等。
正因为是家全球性私有科技集团，它的业务几乎遍布全球。
公司的工作人员也几乎来自世界各地的精英。
这次参加深空探索的宇航员就来自全球七个国家，一共十二人。
张乾出身在山东省临淄的一个普通乡镇，可从小天资聪颖。
从小学到高中一直名列前茅，最后在大考时以山东高考理科第一名成绩考入清华大学。
当时学校老师、亲友都让他报考电子工程或生物医药等专业，这样毕业后就业入职非常容易，且十分抢手，工资收入也会非常可观。
可他非常坚决，闷声不响地填了天体物理专业，父母及亲友也拗不过他的驴脾气，只好随他。
十年前，在一场宇航国际的招聘会上，他有幸认识了一位学长。
在得知张乾基本功课扎实，学的又是天体物理专业，身体素质极佳。
得以这位学长的引见，又经过层层选拔，张乾便顺利进入了宇航国际。
进入宇航国际公司后，他又舍去了最让人动心的空间生物制药等部门，义无反顾地选择了宇航部门。
又经过了许多次考核，选拔，终于成了一名候选宇航员。
在他成为宇航员的前几年，他莫名其妙地经常会做同一类的怪梦，就是他以后会进入一个遥远的太空，进行一场奇异无比的太空历险。
其情节之曲折，过程之奇幻，场景之离奇是他从未见过的，也从未在书本及电脑上真正看到过。
只不过在一些科幻或玄幻小说中看到过。

由于感知到如此的奇特和美妙，这几年他几乎入魔，最后毅然决然地参加宇航员选拔。
张乾凭着超一流的科学文化知识，超一流的身体素质，超一流的心理抗压能力。
得到初步录取后，又经过极其严苛的培训，最后终于愿望成真，成为一名宇航员。
开始的几次升空活动，主要在太阳系内，他也去过空间站，有宇航国际的，有中国的，也有其他国家的。
登陆过月球，也登陆过火星。
一次次的太空经历，使他成为一个出色的宇航员，并出色成为一个出色的宇舰指挥官。
这次空间远航的太空飞船，命名“阿布罗”
号，飞船的总指挥，也称船长就是张乾。
飞船中的宇航员七男五女，另有一位同是中国籍的女宇航员叫李丽君，河南洛阳人。
此次深空探索的住务主要有四个：一是对此次航路及周边领域的空间环境进行探索和研究。
二是进行一系列的基础材料提纯和合成，从而制造一些特殊性能的材料，包括生物医药等材料。
三是最好探寻到能够适合人类生活的星球，也包括对太空人的寻求。
四是在外太空放置一个空天望远镜。
自火箭助推嚣点火后，张乾的心情一直无法平静，这是他以前从未有过的事情。
他一直认为他的心理承受能力，已超过了大部分的修道之人。
可瞬间进入“禅定”
状态，可这次为何如此呢？难道这次因为路程遥远，深空探索的时间较长所致？
这也不应该啊，出征前这些事情他反反复复思量过许多遍，也和父母妻儿交代清楚了，为何总觉得内心惶惶，无法安宁？
第二章太空惊变
航天器在核动力发动机强力推动下，以超越第三宇宙速度的航速下，按照已经设定区域飞速前行，航天器是茫茫太空，已经没有日夜之分，但在航天器内部设计成昼夜变化，以便航天员依旧和地球上生活节奏和规律相适应。

航天器内部除了动力部门，又分工作区，生活区，休息娱乐区，有些区域还人为制造重力区。
此次航天探索任务，五个国家地区包括中国、俄国、巴西、南非、以色列共十二名宇航员，其中七名男性成员，五名女性成员，各人各有专长，张乾为指挥长。
content_en:
On October 25, 2068 AD, about 100 kilometers southeast of Okinawa, Japan, in the Western Pacific Ocean, Aerospace International's seventeenth space launch finally began.
Aerospace International is a private aerospace company mainly responsible for aerospace launch, space exploration, space tourism and other businesses.
After more than a hundred years of unremitting efforts, mankind has finally created a spacecraft with a space engine that uses nuclear power as its main thruster.
Only with the spacecraft using nuclear power as a propeller can humans begin real deep space exploration. Only based on this super power can we fly out of the solar system and realize truly manned deep space exploration.
Aerospace International is an international high-tech enterprise with super strength. Its main businesses include aerospace, biopharmaceuticals, energy development, satellite communications, space travel, etc.
Because it is a global private technology group, its business spans almost all over the world.
The company's staff also come from almost elites from all over the world.
The astronauts participating in the deep space exploration this time come from seven countries around the world, a total of 12 people.
Zhang Qian was born in an ordinary town in Linzi, Shandong Province, and was talented since childhood.
He has always been among the best from elementary school to high school, and finally entered Tsinghua University with the first place in the science subject of the Shandong College Entrance Examination.
At that time, school teachers, relatives and friends asked him to apply for majors such as electronic engineering or biomedicine, which would make it very easy to get a job after graduation, and it would be very popular, and the salary would be very considerable.
But he was very determined and filled in the astrophysics major quietly. His parents, relatives and friends couldn't get over his donkey temper, so they had to let him go.
Ten years ago, at a job fair held by Aerospace International, he was fortunate enough to meet a senior.
After learning that Zhang Qian had solid basic skills, majored in astrophysics, and had excellent physical fitness.
With the senior's introduction and after many rounds of selection, Zhang Qian successfully entered Aerospace International.
After joining Aerospace International Corporation, he gave up the most exciting departments such as space biopharmaceuticals and chose the aerospace department without hesitation.
After many assessments and selections, he finally became a candidate astronaut.
A few years before he became an astronaut, he would inexplicably often have the same type of strange dreams, that is, he would enter a distant space and have a bizarre space adventure.
The twists and turns of the plot, the fantasy of the process, and the bizarre scenes were something he had never seen before, and he had never really seen it in books or on computers.
I've only seen it in some science fiction or fantasy novels.
Because he sensed such strangeness and beauty, he was almost obsessed with it in the past few years, and finally decided to participate in the selection of astronauts.
Zhang Qian relied on his super first-class scientific and cultural knowledge, super first-class physical fitness, and super first-class psychological stress resistance.
After getting preliminary admission, he went through extremely rigorous training, and finally his wish came true and he became an astronaut.
The first few launches were mainly in the solar system. He also visited space stations, including ones from Aerospace International, some from China, and some from other countries.
We have landed on the moon and on Mars.
His repeated space experiences made him an excellent astronaut and an excellent spaceship commander.
The spacecraft on this space voyage is named "Ablo"
No., the commander-in-chief of the spaceship, also known as the captain, is Zhang Qian.
There are seven men and five women astronauts in the spacecraft, and there is another Chinese female astronaut named Li Lijun, who is from Luoyang, Henan.
There are four main tasks for this deep space exploration: First, explore and study the space environment of the route and surrounding areas.
The second is to carry out a series of purification and synthesis of basic materials to produce materials with special properties, including biomedicine and other materials.
Third, it is best to explore planets that are suitable for human life, including the pursuit of astronauts.
The fourth is to place a space in outer spaceSky telescope.
Zhang Qian's mood has been unable to calm down since the rocket was boosted and ignited. This is something he has never experienced before.
He has always believed that his mental endurance has exceeded that of most cultivators.
Can instantly enter "meditation"
state, but why is it like this this time? Could it be that this time it was because of the long distance and the long time required for deep space exploration?
This shouldn't be the case. He thought about these things many times before setting off for the expedition, and explained them clearly to his parents, wife and children. Why did he always feel panicked and unable to settle down?
Chapter 2 Shock in Space
Powered by a nuclear-powered engine, the spacecraft quickly moves forward according to the set area at a speed that exceeds the speed of the third universe. The spacecraft is in the vast space, and there is no distinction between day and night. However, the spacecraft is designed to change day and night so that the astronauts can still adapt to the rhythm and laws of life on earth.
In addition to the power department, the interior of the spacecraft is divided into work areas, living areas, rest and entertainment areas, and some areas also have artificially created gravity zones.
This space exploration mission involves a total of 12 astronauts from five countries and regions, including China, Russia, Brazil, South Africa, and Israel, including seven male members and five female members, each with their own expertise. Zhang Qian is the commander.
